title: Let's make super easy, 2 ingredient green wrap in 10 min for my toddler & myself
caption: Let's make super easy, 2 ingredient green wrap in 10 min for my toddler & myself! 1. Place 2 cups of spinach and 2 eggs in a blender 2. Blend until all ingredients are smoothly blended  3. Pour the mixture into the pan, cook for 3 minutes on each side  4. Add fillings of your choice! I added cream cheese with raspberry jam #blw #babyledweaning #toddlersnackz #keto #ketorecipes #blwideas #blwrecipes #babyfood
